text:
Sophie L.: hey @people-ops :wave: I need to request an accommodation for chronic lower-back pain. standing desk hasn't helped and long oncall nights make it worse. looking for an ergonomic stool + a temporary shift swap for nights next sprint
Mike R.: Thanks for flagging, Sophie. I'm looped in. We can figure coverage. copying @Carla (People Ops) to start the process. please keep any medical details in DM or the secure form.
Carla (People Ops): Hi Sophie — thanks for letting us know. Please upload a brief note to the confidential accommodations form (link below) or DM me the redacted note. We'll treat this as confidential and aim for a quick interim plan.
Carla (People Ops): https://intranet.redwood/hr/accom-form (secure) :lock:
peopleops-bot: Case created: AC-2025-111 by Carla (People Ops). Status: intake.
Jordan P.: I can cover Sophie's oncall nights for the 2025-04-06 -> 2025-04-20 window if that helps. happy to swap.
Sophie L.: thank you @Jordan P. that would help a lot. Mike, if Jordan can cover nights, i can keep daytime async work + attend weekly syncs.
Mike R.: sounds good. @Jordan P. appreciate it — can you add a calendar invite for the nights you'll cover and cc me? also we'll mark this as a temporary adjustment in the team rota.
Jordan P.: will do, sending invite now.
Carla (People Ops): Next steps from People Ops side:
```
1) Sophie uploads confidential note or shares in DM with Carla
2) People Ops confirms interim schedule and documents temporary accommodation
3) People Ops + Manager review reasonable modifications and timeline (default 90 days review)
4) If needed, we can request an occupational health note but we don't always need specific diagnosis details
```
Carla (People Ops): Sophie, you can redact any sensitive specifics on the form. We only need enough to verify functional limitations (e.g., "cannot tolerate standing >30min", "needs seated alternative"). Turnaround ~3 business days once we have the form. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sophie L.: uploaded a redacted note to the form and DM'd Carla the receipt. thanks all for the quick help.
Carla (People Ops): got it, thank you. I've updated Case AC-2025-111 and emailed the manager confirmation. We'll add an accommodations entry to SOP and schedule a check-in in 2 weeks. If anything changes, DM me directly. :thumbsup:
Mike R.: thanks @Carla. Team, let's keep this private — no channel-level discussion of medical details.
Sophie L.: appreciate everyone, feeling much better already that there's a plan. :relieved:
